seo.title: Our Story | Quarterfold Printabilities
seo.description: Powering Global Education Through Print Excellence. Since 2014, we've grown from a single order of 50,000 books to serving 25+ countries with educational materials.

hero.title: Powering Global Education Through Print Excellence
hero.lede: In 2014, Quarterfold Printabilities began with a single order of 50,000 copies for an African publisher. Today, the company prints and delivers educational books for ministries, donor programmes, and publishers across 25+ countries. The scale changed. The promise behind every book did not.

stops.title: The First Order
stops.desc: Founded in Navi Mumbai as a print management company. A single order of 50,000 books for an African publisher sets the direction.

stops.title: Began as a Startup
stops.desc: Annual production grows to 15 to 18 million books for international markets.

stops.title: Our First Facility
stops.desc: First printing facility set up in Navi Mumbai, bringing production quality under direct control.

stops.title: Scale With Systems
stops.desc: Three advanced facilities spanning 300,000 sq ft, with further investment in all new machinery, including a dedicated fulfilment centre. Over 75 million books delivered to various publishers and Ministry of Education programmes.

stops.title: A Global Operation
stops.desc: 800+ containers shipped across 25 countries in a single year. PrintWeek names Quarterfold Printabilities the Book Education Company of the Year.

mission.label: MISSION
mission.desc: Deliver high-quality, cost-effective educational materials through responsible printing, empowering learners across 25+ countries while exceeding the expectations of every publisher, ministry, and institution served.

vision.label: VISION
vision.desc: To lead the global printing industry with innovative, responsible, and affordable solutions that support education, promote a reading culture, and uphold environmental and social accountability.

values.label: VALUES
values.desc: Quality, reliability, and care in every project, whether one thousand copies or one million.

founder.eyebrow: From designer to one of India's most celebrated book printers
founder.name: Nilesh Dhankani
founder.bio: I have always believed that great companies are built by people who dare to think beyond the present. Quarterfold Printabilities was founded with a vision to redefine global printing standards through innovation, integrity, and an unwavering pursuit of excellence. No matter how challenging the assignment, we never shy away from supporting our publishing partners. Every challenge is an opportunity to innovate, every partnership is built on trust, and every success strengthens our commitment to delivering world class solutions.
founder.quote: The best is always yet to come.

members.name: Sameer Kazi
members.bio: With over 20 years of experience in sales and business development, Mr. Sameer Kazi holds an M.Com from the University of Mumbai and an MBA in Marketing. He is passionate about building lasting customer relationships and driving business growth through a customer centric approach.
members.quote: Our greatest strength lies in understanding our customers' needs and delivering beyond expectations. At Quarterfold Printabilities, every partnership is built on trust, responsiveness, and a shared commitment to long term success.

members.name: Charani Dhankani
members.bio: Ms. Charani Dhankani is a distinguished graduate of the University of Delhi, where she topped her department and was awarded a Certificate of Excellence by former Prime Minister Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee. She received specialized training in Marketing and Merchandising from Wigan and Leigh College. Having previously overseen the company's Human Resources function, she is now actively involved in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives and educational development programs.

members.name: Dhiresh Verlekar
members.bio: Mr. Dhiresh Verlekar leads Quarterfold's procurement function, managing a network of 100+ trusted vendor partners across paper, consumables, machinery, and allied services. His focus on supplier resilience, quality, and cost optimization supports the company's large scale production capabilities.
members.quote: A great book begins long before the press starts spinning. By building a resilient supply chain and strong vendor partnerships, we ensure Quarterfold remains a reliable, cost effective partner for publishers worldwide.
